system.description:
This devilish song causes havoc around the singer: Knots untie, wax cracks, mortar loosens, thread unwinds and seams unravel.

Obstacle: See Below

Obstacles: Knots or belts, Ob 1. Rope, Ob 2. In addition, you can use the equivalent obstacle of the Raw Power Obstacles Against Materials table on Burning Wheel page 542 to cause fences, doors, walls or even structures to fall apart.

Actions: Obstacle x2

Dark Elf spell song: follows the rules for Elven spell songs (sorcerous for practice and learning, always open-ended, no tools or FoRKs).

Song root: Will.

Restrictions: Dark Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 424
